data.one_liner: Cross‑platform webview widget using webview_flutter for mobile and iframe for web with JS interop
data.what_it_does: Provides a WebViewX widget and controller that can load URLs, HTML or bypassed URLs. It supports JavaScript execution, media playback policies, and allows Dart callbacks from JavaScript.
use_when: Need to display web content inside a Flutter app on mobile or web
Require JavaScript interop between Dart and the loaded page
Want a simple, declarative API without writing native platform code
avoid_when: Building a highly custom native webview with advanced features like custom rendering or native plugins
Using the widget in a pure web‑only project where iframe is not suitable
strengths: Built‑in JS interop via EmbeddedJsContent and DartCallback
Easy controller API for navigation and content loading
No build_runner or code generation required
weaknesses: Relies on webview_flutter which may have platform limitations
Iframe on web can have gesture and reload quirks
Limited to the features exposed by webview_flutter and iframe
